newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA GO TOP WITH LAST-GASP WIN AT DEPORTIVO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA GO TOP WITH LAST-GASP WIN AT DEPORTIVO.

text.p: An 87th minute strike by substitute Juan Pizzi gave Barcelona a well-deserved 1-0 victory at Deportivo Coruna and with it the lead in the Spanish first division on Saturday.
The result left Barcelona on 40 points, one ahead of Real Madrid who need to win Sunday's game against Athletic Bilbao to go top. Deportivo trail the leaders by three points.
The game marked the re-emergence of Brazilian striker Ronaldo who came within a whisker of breaking his five-game goal-drought as he led Bobby Robson's side in the second half.

Ronaldo twice hit the woodwork and saw another effort cleared off the line. But Pizzi, who had been on the field only two minutes, became the hero of the night after his header caught a deflection to give goalkeeper Jacques Songo'o no chance.
Deportivo's own Brazilian striker, Renaldo, came close to scoring on his debut but was denied by the bar after pouncing on a mistake by Barcelona goalkeeper Vitor Baia in the 35th minute.
